# Finance and runway

> Cash, runway, break-even and scenarios for a small venture, the economics of funding (equity, grants, debt, bootstrapping), and a program for runway and break-even from a model's numbers. The first review is written and a program computes both.

Each page's markdown source is served at the same path with a .md extension. This index is written by hand; AGENTS.md says to keep it in step.

## The repository

- [Finance and runway](https://tewf.github.io/business-finance/README.md): the scope, the first job and the questions its review must answer
- [Evidence](https://tewf.github.io/business-finance/evidence/README.md): the review, 32 sources, ending on the baseline B1, and the bibliography
- [Runway and break-even review](https://tewf.github.io/business-finance/evidence/finance-runway/README.md): frame, protocol, sources, findings, state of the art, position, against, baseline
- [Program](https://github.com/Tewf/business-finance/blob/master/checks/local/runway.py): runway, break-even and the three states from a toml of a model's numbers
- [Decisions](https://tewf.github.io/business-finance/decisions/README.md): one record per choice that shapes the repository

## Contributing

- [Contributing](https://tewf.github.io/business-finance/AGENTS.md): rules for changing this repository
